speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The mission of the Ministry of Law (MinLaw) is to advance access to justice and the rule of law in Singapore, as well as to develop our legal services to support our economy and society.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Working with the people, our partners and stakeholders, we aim to realise our vision of "A Trusted Legal System; A Trusted Singapore".

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MinLaw will continue to review our laws to ensure that they remain progressive, modern and relevant to the evolving needs of our society.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We intend to cover new offences to deal with the changing crime environment, introduce measures to enhance protection for vulnerable victims, and assess the adequacy of existing punishments for sexual offences.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The laws on attempted suicide and marital rape immunity are also being reviewed.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are working closely with the Judiciary and legal practitioners on a broad-based review of our civil justice system.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The aim is to keep legal costs affordable and to reduce complexity of civil proceedings.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To meet these goals, we are reviewing the framework of legal costs and enhancing judicial control in civil proceedings.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are also studying measures to make it easier and more effective for plaintiffs to enforce judgments given in their favour, such as maintenance orders made in matrimonial disputes.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MinLaw will continue to provide legal aid and ensure that justice remains accessible to vulnerable Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also enhance frameworks that enable Singaporeans to resolve their disputes quickly in a cost-effective manner, and as amicably as possible.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Community Mediation Centre provides mediation services and works with other agencies to promote neighbourliness within our communities.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to drive Singapore’s development as an international legal services hub, help our legal professionals acquire expertise in new growth areas, and assist them to access the opportunities afforded by the growth of Asia and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MinLaw will also continue to promote the international use of Singapore law, standards and frameworks in commerce and dispute resolution.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MinLaw will work closely with the Singapore International Arbitration Centre, the Singapore International Mediation Centre, and the Singapore International Commercial Court to strengthen our position as a venue of choice for international dispute resolution.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We have updated the relevant legislation and will strengthen our infrastructure with the expansion of Maxwell Chambers.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will help law firms and lawyers to develop the expertise required to better capture growth opportunities in key legal practice areas, such as restructuring, and projects and infrastructure.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We also launched the Lawyers Go Global programme with the Law Society and the then-International Enterprise (IE) Singapore in early 2018, which will help our law firms seize opportunities abroad through overseas mission trips, and branding and marketing efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Academy of Law has launched the Legal Industry Framework for Training and Education (LIFTED), which supports legal practitioners, inhouse counsel, and legal support/ paralegals.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will work with the Academy, as well as other stakeholders, to support Singaporean lawyers in deepening skills and qualifications through the SkillsFuture Study Awards and SkillsFuture Credit.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Intellectual property (IP) is an area with new growth potential.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are progressively reviewing our IP laws to keep pace with technology changes, strengthen IP protection, and enable industry to tap on potential gains.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To support an innovation-driven economy, the Intellectual Property Office of Singapore will develop more expertise in IP management, strategy and valuation, and help our businesses realise the full value of their IP through its IP ValueLab.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Singapore is a responsible member of the international community, and we strive to fulfill our international obligations, such as our efforts in Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We have been actively participating in international law-making at regional and multilateral forums.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will further the development of international law expertise in emerging issues through the support of local think-tanks.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In line with the Smart Nation initiative, MinLaw and its Statutory Boards have embarked on digitalisation efforts to raise productivity and work efficiency, and to improve service delivery.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We aim to improve the user experience by revamping our digital platforms, implementing mobile app-based services and employing data analytics to better understand our customers.
